data.rationale: The proposal follows the same four-stage procedure in the same order with the same three parameters (nationality, country, month); it is mildly less precise on a few points: it adds a {nationality_adj} parameter that isn't listed, leaves the note's {visa_requirement}, {stay} and {holidays} placeholders to be filled from the pages, and doesn't spell out the "New note" click or tab switching, so an automation would need small inferences.
